verdict.rationale: Breach alerts and credential-health warnings are a reasonable question for a credential-security app like an authenticator, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only TOTP/HOTP code generation, sync, transfer, editing, search and Privacy Screen. Nothing shows the app warns about breached services or weak, reused or exposed credentials.

support.subject: As a power user, the app warns me when a service I use is breached or a stored credential is weak, reused, or exposed
